title_zh: 亞什特 第 18 首‧阿什塔德讚
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）

segments.orig:
(pa nãm i ýazdã, hôrmezd i hvadâe
i awazûnî gurz hvarahe awazâyât,
âshtât ýazat bê rasât,
 ezh hamâ gunâh ... pa patit hôm!) 
xshnaothra ahurahe mazdå, tarôidîti angrahe
mainyêush, haithyâvarshtãm hyat vasnâ
ferashôtemem. staomî ashem,
ashem vohû...(3).
fravarâne mazdayasnô zarathushtrish vîdaêvô
ahura-tkaêshô,
 (Here recite the appropriate Gah dedication.) 
airyanãm hvarenô mazdadhâtanãm
xshnaothra ýasnâica vahmâica xshnaothrâica
frasastayaêca,
ýathâ ahû vairyô zaotâ frâ-mê
mrûtê,
athâ ratush ashâtcît haca frâ ashava vîdhvå
mraotû!
segments.en:
May Ahura Mazda be rejoiced!....
Ashem Vohu: Holiness is the best of all good....
I confess myself a worshipper of Mazda, a follower of Zarathushtra.
one who hates the Daevas and obeys the laws of Ahura;
For sacrifice, prayer, propitiation, and glorification unto [Havani],
the holy and master of holiness ....
Unto the Glory of the Aryans, made by Mazda,
Be propitiation, with sacrifice, prayer, propitiation, and glorification.
Yatha ahu vairyo: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness....
segments.zh:
願阿胡拉‧馬茲達歡喜！....
阿舍姆‧沃胡：神聖是眾善中至善....
我自認是馬茲達的崇拜者，是查拉圖斯特拉的追隨者，
是憎恨達埃瓦、服從阿胡拉律法的人；
為了向〔哈瓦尼〕，神聖者與神聖之主，獻上犧牲、祈禱、贖罪與讚美....
願亞利安人的榮耀，馬茲達所造的，
得享贖罪，以犧牲、祈禱、贖罪與讚美。
亞塔‧阿胡‧瓦伊里約：主的意願是神聖的律法....

segments.orig:
mraot ahurô mazdå spitamâi zarathushtrâi,
azem dadhãm airyanem hvarenô gaomavaitîm pouru-
vãthwem pouru-ishtem pouru-hvarenanghem hush-hãm-beretem
xrathwem hush-hãm-beretem shaêtem âzîm
hamaêstârem dushmainyûm hamaêstârem.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda spake unto Spitama Zarathushtra, saying: 'I made
the Aryan Glory, rich in food, rich in flocks, rich in wealth,
rich in Glory; provided with full store of intelligence, with
full store of money, to withstand Need, and to withstand enemies.
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達對斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉說：『我造了
亞利安人的榮耀，富於食物，富於牲畜，富於財富，
富於榮耀；滿載智慧，
滿載金錢，以抵禦匱乏，並抵禦敵人。』

segments.orig:
taurvayeiti angrem mainyûm pouru-mahrkem, taurvayeiti
aêshmem xrvîdrûm, taurvayeiti bûshyãstem
zairinem, taurvayeiti hãm-steretem aêxem, taurvayeiti
daêum apaoshem, taurvayeiti anairyå dainghâvô.
segments.en:
'It destroys Angra Mainyu, who is all death; it destroys Aeshma,
the fiend of the wounding spear; it destroys the yellow Bushyasta;
it destroys the contagion of Aekha; it destroys the fiend of death,
Apaosha; it destroys the non-Aryan nations.
segments.zh:
『它毀滅安格拉‧曼紐，那全然的死亡；它毀滅埃什瑪，
那傷人之矛的惡魔；它毀滅黃色的布希亞斯塔；
它毀滅埃卡之傳染；它毀滅死亡之魔，
阿帕奧沙；它毀滅非亞利安人的部族。』

segments.orig:
azem dadhãm ashîmca vanguhîm berezaitîm,
fracaraiti añtare aredhem nmânahe srîrahe xshathrô-
keretahe.
segments.en:
'And I made the great Ashi Vanguhi; she comes in, amid the
family; she comes in, inside the fine royal palace.
segments.zh:
『我又造了偉大的阿希‧萬古希；她進入
家中；她進入那華美的王宮之內。』

segments.orig:
tem hacât ashish pourush-hvâthra râiti ashava-
xshnvaityâi mashyâi, fracaraiti añtare aredhem
nmânahe srîrahe xshathrô- keretahe, vîspô-vãthwô
vîspô-verethrô vîspô-xrathwô
vîspô-hvarenô, aêvô-pâdhem
nidathaite ashish vanguhi ýâ berezaiti añtare
aredhem nmânahe srîrahe xshathrô-keretahe.
segments.en:
'Let Ashi, with fulness of welfare, follow the man who gladdens
the faithful with his gifts! she comes in, inside his family;
she comes in, inside his fine royal palace.
'With all sorts of flocks, with all victory, with all intelligence,
with all Glory, the great Ashi Vanguhi puts one foot inside his
family; she comes in, inside his fine royal palace.
segments.zh:
『願阿希，以圓滿的福祉，跟隨那以禮物
使信徒歡喜的人！她進入他的家中；
她進入他華美的王宮之內。
帶著各種牲畜，帶著一切勝利，帶著一切智慧，
帶著一切榮耀，偉大的阿希‧萬古希將一隻腳踏入他的
家中；她進入他華美的王宮之內。』

segments.orig:
hazangrem aspå bavaiti hazangrem vãthwå
bavaiti uta âsnãmcit frazaiñtîm, hâmô
ýaozaiti tishtrîm stârem hâmô vâtô
darshish mazdadhâtô hâmô airyanem hvarenô.
segments.en:
'Horses multiply a thousandfold, flocks multiply a thousandfold;
and so does his virtuous offspring, (as) the bright, glorious
star Tishtrya moves on equally, and so does the strong wind made
by Mazda, and so does the Glory of the Aryas.
segments.zh:
『馬匹繁衍千倍，牲畜繁衍千倍；
他那有德的後代也是如此，（正如）明亮、光榮的
蒂什特里亞星平穩運行，馬茲達所造的強風
也是如此，亞利安人的榮耀也是如此。』

segments.orig:
uta bareñti fradathem
vîspå bareshnavô gairinãm
vîspå jãfnavô raonãm
uta bareñti fradathem
vîspanãm urvaranãm frâurustanãm
srîranãm zairi-gaonanãm uta bareñti
fradathem hãm-steretem aêxem uta bareñti mahrkathem
daêum apaoshem.
segments.en:
'And they bring increase on the tops of all mountains, down
the depths of all vales; they bring increase to all the growing
plants, the fair, the golden-hued. And they bring (away) the contagion
of Aekha, they bring (away) the fiend of death, Apaosha.
segments.zh:
『它們在一切山巔、
一切谷底帶來增長；它們為一切
生長的植物、美麗的、金黃色的植物帶來增長。
它們也帶走埃卡之傳染，它們帶走死亡之魔，
阿帕奧沙。』

segments.orig:
nemô tishtrîm stârem raêvañtem
hvarenanghuñtem nemô vâtô darshish mazdadhâtô
nemô airyanem hvarenô. ýathâ ahû
vairyô...(4). ashem vohû...(3).
segments.en:
'Hail to the bright and glorious star Tishtrya Hail to the
strong wind, made by Mazda! Hail to the Glory of the Aryas!
'Yatha ahu vairyo: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness....
'Ashem Vohu: Holiness is the best of all good....
segments.zh:
『致敬那明亮而光榮的蒂什特里亞星！致敬那
馬茲達所造的強風！致敬亞利安人的榮耀！
亞塔‧阿胡‧瓦伊里約：主的意願是神聖的律法....
阿舍姆‧沃胡：神聖是眾善中至善....』

segments.orig:
ahunem vairîm ýazamaide, ashem vahishtem sraêshtem
ameshem speñtem ýazamaide, vaca arshuxdha vârethrakhnish
baêshazish ýazamaide, baêshazish vaca arshuxdha
vârethrakhnish ýazamaide, mãthra speñta
daêna mâzdayesne haomacanem ýazamaide, airyanem
hvarenô ýazamaide,
ýenghê hâtãm âat ýesnê
paitî vanghô mazdå ahurô vaêthâ
ashât hacâ ýånghãmcâ tãscâ
tåscâ ýazamaide!
segments.en:
'We worship the Ahuna Vairya.
'We worship Asha-Vahishta, the fairest Amesha-Spenta.
'We worship the rightly-spoken Words, fiend-smiting and healing.
'We worship the healing, well-spoken Words, the fiend-smiting.
'We worship the Mathra Spenta and the Law of Mazda, and (piety)
that delights in Haoma.
'We worship the Glory of the Aryas.
'Yenhe hatam: All those beings of whom Ahura Mazda....
segments.zh:
'我們崇拜阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞
'我們崇拜阿沙‧瓦希什塔，最美的大天神
'我們崇拜正確說出的言辭，擊敗邪魔並治癒
'我們崇拜治癒、正確說出的言辭，擊敗邪魔
'我們崇拜曼特拉‧斯彭塔與馬茲達之律，以及（虔誠）喜愛豪麻的。
'我們崇拜雅利安人之榮耀。
'Yenhe hatam: 所有那些被阿胡拉‧馬茲達....的眾生

segments.orig:
(hôrmezd i hvadâe i awazûnî mardum
mardum sardagã hamâ sardagã ham bâ ýasht
i vahã vaem vahe dîn i mâzdayasnã âgâhî
âstvãnî nêkî rasãnât
êduñ bât,)
segments.en:
'Yatha ahu vairyo: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness....
'I bless the sacrifice and prayer, and the strength and vigour
of the Glory of the Aryas, made by Mazda.
'Ashem Vohu: Holiness is the best of all good....
'[Give] unto that man brightness and glory, .... give him the
bright, all-happy, blissful abode of the holy Ones.'
segments.zh:
'雅他 阿胡 威里奧: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達的意志是聖潔之律....
'我祝福祭祀與祈禱，以及雅利安人之榮耀的力量與活力，由馬茲達所造。
'阿舍姆‧沃胡: 聖潔是一切善事中最好的....
'[Give] 給予那人光明與榮耀，.... 給他光明、普遍幸福、快樂的聖者居所。'
